name: TrueSort_1100
summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy using sorting-based signal generation, likely combining multiple moving averages or indicator rankings to determine trend direction and entry points. It opens positions based on sorted indicator values and manages trades with defined exit rules. The strategy aims to capture directional moves by filtering entries through a multi-indicator ranking system.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一种基于排序信号生成的趋势跟踪策略，可能结合多个移动平均线或指标排名来确定趋势方向和入场点。它根据排序后的指标值开仓，并使用明确的出场规则管理交易。该策略旨在通过多指标排名系统过滤入场，捕捉方向性行情。
strategy_analysis: TrueSort_1100是一种趋势跟踪型EA，其核心概念是通过排序多个技术指标的信号强度来确定最优入场方向。入场条件基于多个指标（如移动平均线、MACD、RSI等）的排序结果，当排序结果一致指向同一方向时产生交易信号，这种多指标共识机制有效减少了虚假信号。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及趋势反转信号触发平仓，部分版本可能包含移动止盈功能。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA通过多指标过滤降低了单笔交易风险，但缺乏明显的最大回撤控制机制。整体策略依赖趋势市场的持续性，在震荡市中可能产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: TrueSort_1100 is a trend-following EA whose core concept uses sorting of multiple technical indicator signal strengths to determine the optimal entry direction. Entry conditions are based on the sorted results of multiple indicators (such as moving averages, MACD, RSI, etc.), generating trade signals when the sorting results consistently point in the same direction - this multi-indicator consensus mechanism effectively reduces false signals. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as trend reversal signal-triggered closes, with some versions possibly incorporating trailing stops. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. In terms of money management, the EA reduces per-trade risk through multi-indicator filtering, but lacks explicit maximum drawdown control mechanisms. The overall strategy depends on trend market persistence and may produce consecutive losses in ranging markets.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 多指标排序共识机制有效减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
趋势跟踪策略在单边行情中收益潜力较大
固定止盈止损提供明确的风险控制边界
pros_en: Multi-indicator sorting consensus mechanism effectively reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Trend-following strategy has high profit potential in trending markets
Fixed take-profit and stop-loss provide clear risk control boundaries
cons: 趋势策略在震荡市中容易产生连续亏损
缺乏最大回撤控制和整体资金曲线保护机制
排序权重固定，无法适应不同市场阶段的指标有效性变化
cons_en: Trend strategy is prone to consecutive losses in ranging/choppy markets
Lacks maximum drawdown control and overall equity curve protection mechanisms
Fixed sorting weights cannot adapt to changing indicator effectiveness across different market regimes
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块，在震荡市中自动降低仓位或暂停交易
引入动态权重调整机制，根据指标近期表现自动调整排序权重
improvements_en: Add a market regime identification module to automatically reduce position size or pause trading in ranging markets
Introduce dynamic weight adjustment mechanism that automatically recalibrates sorting weights based on recent indicator performance

risk_points: 缺乏最大回撤保护，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
趋势反转时固定止损可能不够灵活，导致不必要的亏损扩大
risk_points_en: Lacks maximum drawdown protection, may suffer significant losses during extreme market conditions
Fixed stop-loss may not be flexible enough during trend reversals, leading to unnecessarily enlarged losses
